name: 53594 · Waterloo, WI
findings: ZIP 53594 (Waterloo) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53594 (Waterloo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
